meshify.mod.description: Select a region with /pos start and /pos end, then export it to OBJ + MTL + textures. Supports modded blocks, block entities, entities, and optional greedy-mesh UV baking for polygon reduction. Based on the pos2obj mod on CurseForge by usagi_san.
meshify.msg.hint: [Meshify] Export with /pos export <name> [options…] (press Tab for options)
meshify.msg.pre_unloaded: [Meshify] %s chunk(s) in range are not loaded and will export as air — fly closer or raise your render distance
meshify.msg.pre_large: [Meshify] Large region (%s blocks): the world scan will freeze the game briefly, then writing continues in the background
meshify.msg.weld_summary: [Meshify] Optimize: %s → %s faces (removed %s degenerate, %s duplicate; weld grid 1/%s block)
meshify.error.no_selection: [Meshify] Set the region first with /pos start and /pos end
meshify.error.wrong_dimension: [Meshify] The selection belongs to %s — go back there or run /pos clear
meshify.opt.desc.atlas: Pack every texture into a single image (default)
meshify.opt.desc.bake: Merge faces and bake textures into new UVs (large polygon reduction)
meshify.opt.desc.weld: Weld vertices and remove degenerate/duplicate faces
meshify.opt.desc.cull: Aggressively cull faces hidden behind opaque neighbors
meshify.opt.desc.uv: Bake resolution: %s px per block face
meshify.opt.desc.uv_default: Bake resolution: %s px per block face (default)
